implementation.patch_application: Applied after EGO patches 0001-0003 to pinned upstream commit; reconstructed post-0003 application and compared changed files.
behavior: Checks depth health and localization status before accepting current depth frames.
Interpolates optimized IMU-frame odometry at each depth source stamp without extrapolation and applies model-derived IMU-to-depth optical extrinsics.
Waits for /mapping/reset_map acknowledgement before publishing paired depth and camera pose to the existing EGO plan_env mapper.
Requests a fresh map_id and clears pending inputs when the localization epoch changes or an active map is invalidated.
The EGO patch resets occupancy and raycast state and skips zero-valued depth pixels rather than marking them as free rays.
implementation.provisional_policy: Interpolation bracket, status receipt age, pending limits, and valid-pixel sampling thresholds remain PROVISIONAL.

result.qualification: synthetic ROS integration smoke only; no physical geometry, planner response, or PX4 qualification

observations: The probe found 5 exact shared depth/pose source stamps and frame odom_<epoch>.
plan_env emitted a map with 4 occupied points from sparse synthetic 32FC1 depth.
After an invalid localization status, plan_env emitted an empty occupancy map; the probe continued publishing depth and observed no further depth or pose outputs.
The reset service acknowledgement and map clear are also recorded in the adapter and EGO launch logs.

debug_history: An early synthetic probe used volatile durability for /localization/status and received no adapter output; the probe publisher was corrected to reliable transient-local QoS before the reported run.
The first full build failure is retained as a repaired attempt and is excluded from the successful build result.

qualification.static_build: PASS: all 16 workspace packages, followed by a successful rebuild of uav_interfaces, uav_sim, and uav_mapping after the last adapter code change.

limitations: Synthetic probe does not validate camera calibration against moving geometry or prove obstacle-clearance quality.
Four occupied points validate data reaches the existing mapper; they do not validate free/unknown classification, map completeness, inflation, or planner use.
The invalid-status case is one integration smoke, not the repeated fault-injection requirement in GOAL.md.
No PX4 or control node was started; no planner response, snapshot, VINS replay, SITL, or hardware claim is made.
